queryPlans.sql:
SELECT qb_question.question_id 
FROM qb_question 
WHERE qb_question.subject_id = 1 AND qb_question.status = '0' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM qb_question_readiness 
WHERE qb_question_readiness.question_id = qb_question.question_id AND qb_question.readiness_revision IS NOT NULL AND qb_question_readiness.question_revision = qb_question.readiness_revision AND qb_question_readiness.subject_id = qb_question.subject_id AND qb_question_readiness.source_provider = qb_question.source_provider AND qb_question_readiness.external_question_id <=> qb_question.external_question_id AND qb_question_readiness.content_hash <=> qb_question.content_hash AND qb_question_readiness.status = 'ready' AND qb_question_readiness.stem_valid = 1 AND qb_question_readiness.assets_ready = 1)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM qb_question_catalog 
WHERE qb_question_catalog.question_id = qb_question.question_id AND qb_question_catalog.catalog_id IN (1) AND qb_question_catalog.relation_type = 'query_catalog')) ORDER BY qb_question.question_id DESC 
 LIMIT 20

sourceVersion: 本文件所属修复提交；下列源码SHA256可复核

filterCases.0: 整本教材，默认20题分页；同时统计匹配总数和未选数量
filterCases.2: 目录1 + 解答题 + 容易 + 年份>=2025 + 山东/青岛 + 无图片/无表格

measurement: 每种筛选、补齐20题、保存版本Word20题各10次，包含首次；p95为nearest-rank。200题Word为一次上限导出。RSS为测试进程峰值，非每请求增量。
limitations: 合成题干相同、无素材下载，不代表真实长题和生产服务器；复杂素材Word沿用已有验收，本轮未重跑。
